# TC.Config.SignalID

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.Config.SignalID"></a>

### TC.Config.SignalID

Accepted input for SignalID. Unknown fields refused. registered_signal: Installed signal identity required. explicit_signal_type: Input signal type must be explicit. Explicit type/name required on input; output includes explicit type/name/quality. Default quality normal. Wildcards depend on role, not general SignalID permission.

### name

Exact prototype/quality identity named by the enclosing concept; no localization lookup. At most 256 bytes; no NUL.

```text
string
```

### quality (optional)

Exact installed quality name; normalization defaults normal where this concept permits omission. At most 256 bytes; no NUL. Installed quality name, never a native object.

```text
string
```

### type

Signal prototype namespace; SignalID/SignalIDBase require an explicit input type.

```text
TC.Config.SignalIDType
```
